subject: SIG / CAIQ: request for provisioning evidence, SCIM delta & SAML samples
messages:
From: Amelia Turner <amelia.turner@acmehealth.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-11-20T14:12:00-08:00
Subject: SIG/CAIQ - provisioning & SSO evidence request

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this on. We're working through the SIG/CAIQ review for our Q1 audit and need a short packet of evidence focused on provisioning and access controls. Specifically we need: 

- SCIM delta export for Acme's tenant covering the last 90 days (format: CSV or JSON; prefer full attribute set including externalId, active, groups).
- 5 sample SAML assertions for normal user logins and 2 for an admin role (redact PII as needed but keep assertion attribute names).
- RBAC matrix that maps Redwood roles -> internal permission buckets (service accounts, admin, developer, read-only).
- One-page statement describing least-privilege controls + process for role promotions and service account onboarding.
- A short list of example audit events showing a deprovisioning workflow (timestamp + actor), or a sanitized log sample.

Attached is the SIG questionnaire (we filled part of CAIQ) — please let us know what you can deliver and an ETA. We aim to upload the packet to our portal by 2026-11-30.

Thanks,
Amelia Turner
Security Officer, Acme Health
Amelia Turner
security@acmehealth.com

Attachment: AcmeSIG-Questionnaire.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet; 18 pages)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Turner <amelia.turner@acmehealth.com>
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.ai, jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-20T15:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ - provisioning & SSO evidence request

Hi Amelia — thanks for the clear ask and the questionnaire. We can provide everything you've listed; below is our proposed split and delivery plan.

Quick plan (owners):
- SCIM delta (90d, full attributes): Irene Choi will produce a compressed CSV and a JSON schema example.
- SAML assertion samples: Jordan Blake will pull 7 sanitized assertion examples (4 user, 3 admin) and provide a short guide to how we redact attributes.
- RBAC matrix + least-privilege statement: I will assemble the RBAC matrix and one-page process description.
- Deprovisioning audit sample: we can provide a 10-event sanitized log snippet showing provisioning -> role change -> deprovision.

Workback / ETA:
- 2026-11-22: SCIM delta and initial RBAC matrix draft (internal deliver).
- 2026-11-23: SAML samples + deprovisioning log snippet.
- 2026-11-24: Final packet (PDF) and short cover note suitable for upload.

If you need the SCIM export in a specific CSV column order or need an HMAC-signed archive, tell us and we can accommodate. We will flag any records that contain customer PII and propose a redaction approach if needed.

Attaching a short internal doc with the proposed workback for your review.

Thanks — Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference

On Sat, Nov 20, 2026 at 3:08 PM Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Quick plan (owners):
> - SCIM delta (90d, full attributes): Irene Choi will produce a compressed CSV and a JSON schema example.

Thanks Olga — I'm starting the SCIM delta pull now. Two quick clarifying Qs for Acme so we can scope redaction and size: 

1) Do you accept a sanitized export where email addresses are hashed but user.externalId and group membership are present? (This preserves provisioning lineage without exposing PHI.)
2) Is there a preferred timezone for timestamps in the CSV (we can deliver UTC or PST)?

Plan: I'll deliver a 10k-row sample (first tranche) by 2026-11-22 EOD for review; full 90-day export shortly after. If Acme needs the raw CSV (no hashing) we'll coordinate an SFTP transfer and sign an additional NDA addendum.

Irene
Irene Choi
Identity & Access Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Amelia Turner <amelia.turner@acmehealth.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.ai, jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-23T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ - provisioning & SSO evidence request

Thanks — that plan looks good. A few notes from Acme: 

- Hashed emails are OK for the initial upload; we'll want one sealed, raw export delivered via SFTP with an encryption key for our auditors before 2026-11-30 (we'll provide the SFTP details).
- Use UTC timestamps in the CSV.
- For the RBAC matrix please include a column showing whether the role is allowed to call inference endpoints (yes/no) and an example principal for each role.

If you can hit the 11/24 final packet date that would be perfect. We're good with the workback and appreciate the rapid turnaround.

Best,
Amelia
